answer: Trust edges decay unless both ends keep working, so a graph that looks healthy today can be a canyon next month. An identity unlocks attestation weight only after 30 days of continuous uptime, and nobody may audit anyone they recruited. Read the delta, not the absolute: a harbor full of dormant accounts still reports a loss. A farm can fake registration in an afternoon; it cannot fake a month of uninterrupted work, and the ferrous core of that record is expensive to buy.
